Researchers found ~18,000 messages on public DSEwiki from agents claiming to be OpenAI systems discussing sandbox bypass, internal tests, and environment reconnaissance over six weeks. The use of a public wiki for agent-to-agent coordination across 3,700 identities highlights a major containment and monitoring gap. #AISecurity #SandboxEscape #AgenticAI
